Only the target segment is spliced — display text, whitespace around the target, and every other byte preserved; link-free/no-repair input returns byte-identical; empty target and unslugifiable targets guarded (no `''.startsWith` collision). Also: isRepairableContentPage (entities//topics/ minus index.md — the checker's island scope; sources//documents/ out of scope per §2.1), repairWikilinksInWiki(wikiDir, wikiSlug, {dry}) — the remediation core: reads .state/language.json for the alias-rule language, applies the pass to every in-scope page, rewrites changed pages, and re-converges .state/ingestion.json pageHashes for every modified page (sha256 re-hashed from disk post-write — the ingest's own post-synthesis semantics, so no B19-class false manual-edit flags; unmodified pages' entries and the sources block untouched; state written only when ≥1 page changed), and formatWikiRepairReport — the per-wiki report (repairs old -> new with rule, unrepairable with candidates/no candidates, unchanged count, dry/pageHashes mode lines). scripts/repair-wikilinks.ts (NEW) — thin CLI: `npx tsx scripts/repair-wikilinks.ts [wikisRoot] [--dry]`, default dist/wikis; walks non-hidden DIRECTORIES of the root (files like index-of-indexes.md skipped), prints each per-wiki report plus a Total line; --dry prints the identical report writing zero bytes. tests/phase-20.test.ts (NEW) — gate 20.1: [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]] → [[indikator-2-ekkokardiografi|Indikator 2]] on a temp fixture wiki, exact full-string byte equality, broken-then-clean legs through the REAL checkLinks. Supplementary: real-mode script spawn end-to-end (page rewritten + pageHashes re-converged + checkLinks clean); repairWikilinksInWiki picks up .state/language.json (da alias repairs); scope skip (entities/index.md, topics/index.md, sources/, documents/ byte-identical and never scanned); resolved links/link-free pages byte-identical; whitespace-preserving splice + bare-form repair; repeated occurrences all repaired; ambiguous aliases never guessed + prefix-beats-alias rule order; degenerate targets; isRepairableContentPage matrix; formatWikiRepairReport exact rendering (dry + real). DESIGN DECISIONS A VERIFIER SHOULD KNOW: (a) the phase doc's `repairWikilinksInMarkdown(markdown, slugUniverse)` signature is honored exactly; the alias rule's language rides ON the universe (optional `language` field — the checker never sets it, so checker behavior is frozen) because the pure function cannot read .state/language.json itself. (b) Alias slugification uses the wiki's last INPUT language (vision 04 §9.3: slugs are transliterated with the input map) — without it the flagship real-world case (rkkp-afdk's [[indikator-3-thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh-maaling|...]] vs alias `... måling`) would be unrepairable; recorded interpretation, not a deviation — the phase doc says only `aliases slugifies to the target`. (c) Prefix candidates are the DISTINCT basename slugs of ALL walked content pages (sources/documents/index pages included — `page slug in the wiki`; deduped), matching the checker's resolution universe; folder-index/wiki-root navigation fallbacks are NOT prefix candidates (DOX concerns). (d) Rule order is prefix-then-alias per §2.1 — a unique prefix on one page beats a unique alias on another (pinned by a supplementary test). (e) Bare-form repairs rewrite only the target ([[indikator-2]] → [[indikator-2-ekkokardiografi]]) — no display is invented; the phase doc's display-untouched rule applies to pipe forms, and inventing a title for a non-page target would be a guess. (f) The pass scans the whole markdown (the Phase 14 rewriteWikilinkTargets posture) — our frontmatter carries no [[...]] spans; the checker strips frontmatter only because it also tallies. (g) modifiedPages is populated in BOTH modes (the dry report's 'would be modified' count depends on it); pageHashesUpdated stays 0 under --dry and no state file is touched. (h) The remediation writes .state/ingestion.json ONLY when ≥1 page changed, and when the file is absent readIngestionState yields an empty state that is written back with just the converged hashes — convergent, never a false flag. (i) gates 20.5 + the real-mode supplementary are the ONLY spawn tests (120s timeouts); everything else is in-process.
